names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 31 octombrie, «Sfântul Apostol Apelie».
Read out of saint.gr's line for 31 Οκτωβρίου, «Άγιοι Στάχυς, Απελλής, Αμπλίας, Ουρβανός, Νάρκισσος και Αριστόβουλος οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα», with the rank words left off.

Read out of the day's own kontakion for the six, which prints the name in the Slavonic — «Апеллия, Урвана же и Аристовула» — and out of the line, which declines it the same way. **Not read off the name link**, which is titled for another man of a like name, «Апостол от 70-ти Аполлос Александриец»; the nominative «Апеллий» is the form the calendar's separate life for him is headed with, «Апостол Апеллий из числа 70-ти».

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 31. октобар ст. ст., „Св. апостоли: Стахије, Амплије, Урван, Наркис, Апелије и Аристовул.“ — «Св. апостоли» is "holy" plus the `apostle` grade, and the other five names are the heading’s other members, so the bare personal name is the whole of the form; «у Ираклији Тракијској» is the body’s and the see without its province is already the folder’s `office`. `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM`.

feast.note: The Greek and Romanian calendars keep the same six apostles on their own 31 October; this is the Russian calendar's own day and not a second day on one calendar. The days his name link lists are not all his: see the row's note.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Апп. от 70-ти Стахия , Амплия , Урвана , Наркисса , Апеллия и Аристовула (I).»
source.note: The line is the first of the day. The day carries one typikon sign only, «Cовершается служба, не отмеченная в Типиконе никаким знаком», so no rank is recorded.

attestations.note: The Russian agrees with the see the other two calendars gave him — «Святой Апеллий святительствовал в Ираклии» — and adds the century and the two hymns. **Its name link is not his name**: the link behind «Апеллия» is `/name/244.html`, titled «Апостол от 70-ти Аполлос Александриец», and its «Дни памяти» are «4 января (70 ап.) , 30 марта , 10 сентября , 31 октября , 8 декабря». That 8 декабря is the day the Greek calendar keeps this corpus's `apollos-the-apostle`, Apollos of Caesarea, on — so **the page is an index of a name and holds two men**, and it lists among its own lives both the six's life and a separate «Апостол Апеллий из числа 70-ти». The folder takes the see from the day's life and the name from the day's line and its kontakion, which prints «Апеллия» in the Slavonic and not «Аполлоса», and nothing is read off the link's title. The same shape was met on 30 октября with «Марка», where the name link titles the Evangelist and the day's life makes him bishop of Apollonias; there no hymn named the man, and the row was refused and reported.

source.text: saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 31ης Οκτωβρίου — «Άγιοι Στάχυς, Απελλής, Αμπλίας, Ουρβανός, Νάρκισσος και Αριστόβουλος οι Απόστολοι από τους Εβδομήκοντα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 31 Οκτωβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and the man is the folder's own: «Ο Άγιος Απελλής έγινε επίσκοπος Ηράκλειας και πολλούς έφερε στη χριστιανική πίστη». No year, so the folder's dateless state is unchanged. Both hymns name all six of the company and are taken into all six folders; the page's first Ἀπολυτίκιον is a common of apostles and is not drafted. No asterisk and not the sentence «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη η ύπαρξη του Αγίου».

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 13.11.2025 (31. октобар ст. ст.) — „Св. апостоли: Стахије, Амплије, Урван, Наркис, Апелије и Аристовул.“

attestations.note: The day’s first entry, fifth of the six apostles it enumerates. THE HEADING ENUMERATES SIX APOSTLES — «Стахије, Амплије, Урван, Наркис, Апелије и Аристовул» — the largest company in this six-day block, so the brief’s enumeration ruling makes it one folder per named member and all the rows quote the whole heading. FIVE of the six take a row here. THE SIXTH, Аристовул, TAKES NOTHING: `aristobulus-of-britain` already carries a venerated serbian row on the Julian 16 March out of this same book AND already holds the Serbian form «Аристовул», so section 1 makes him report-only. «Св. апостоли» is the `apostle` grade all six folders already hold and the body’s «Од Седамдесеторице» is the same claim. `types` UNTOUCHED: `apostle` and `bishop`, and NO `hieromartyr` — his own sentence states a see and nothing else, and the martyrdom in the paragraph belongs by name to Ampliatus and Urban. `dates` UNTOUCHED: `death` 1 to 100 off the Russian «(I)», no year here. WHAT THE BOOK ADDS: ONE WORD, AND IT IS A REAL ONE. «Апелије свети би епископ у Ираклији Тракијској» — bishop in Heraclea OF THRACE. The folder’s `office` reads «Bishop in Heraclea» with no province, and there is more than one Heraclea; this book names Thrace. The `office` WAS NOT REWRITTEN — an office is not a reader’s to change under section 10 — and the province is in the life and in the report instead. NO `related` AT ALL, WHICH IS WORTH STATING: this folder has none, and unlike every other man in this heading the book names nobody with him — not Andrew, not Philip, not Barnabas. He is the one apostle of the six this paragraph leaves unattached. No `locations`. THE FORM IS FREE: `foldchk.py` returns `NO FOLDER HOLDS THIS FORM` for «Апелије». The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Sfinţilor Apostoli, rugaţi pe Milostivul Dumnezeu, ca să dea iertare de greşeli sufletelor noastre.

source.text: doxologia.ro, Troparul Sfinților Apostoli Apelie, Stahie, Amplie, Urban, Aristobul și Narcis, Glasul 3

english.text: Holy Apostles, entreat the merciful God that he may grant our souls forgiveness of our offences.

hymns.text: Τὴν κιθάραν τοῦ Πνεύματος τὴν ἑξάχορδον, τὴν μελῳδήσασαν κόσμῳ τὰς ὑπὲρ νοῦν δωρεάς, ὡς ἐκφάντορας Χριστοῦ ἀνευφημήσωμεν, Στάχυν Ἀμπλίαν Ἀπελλῆν σὺν Ναρκίσσῳ Οὐρβανόν, καὶ Ἀριστόβουλον ἅμα· ὡς γὰρ Ἀπόστολοι θεῖοι, χάριν αἰτοῦνται ταῖς ψυχαῖς ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Έτερον Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος πλ. α’, Τὸν συνάναρχον Λόγον — the second hymn on the page of the six. It names all six of them and no other saint.

english.text: Let us praise the six-stringed lyre of the Spirit, which sang to the world the gifts that are past understanding, as the revealers of Christ — Stachys, Amplias, Apelles with Narcissus, Urban, and Aristobulus together; for as divine Apostles they ask grace for our souls.

hymns.text: Ὡς ἱερὰ κειμήλια, τοῦ Παναγίου Πνεύματος, καὶ τοῦ Ἡλίου τῆς δόξης αὐγάσματα, χρεωστικῶς ὑμνήσωμεν, τοὺς σοφοὺς Ἀποστόλους, Ἀπελλῆν Οὐρβανόν τε καὶ Ἀριστόβουλον, Ἀμπλίαν Νάρκισσον καὶ Στάχυν, οὓς ἡ χάρις συνήγαγε τοῦ Θεοῦ ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr, Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος πλ. δ’, Ὡς ἀπαρχὰς τῆς φύσεως — on the page of the six. It names all six of them and no other saint.

english.text: As sacred treasures of the All-Holy Spirit and rays of the Sun of glory, let us hymn as we are bound the wise Apostles — Apelles and Urban and Aristobulus, Amplias, Narcissus and Stachys — whom the grace of our God gathered together.

hymns.text: Апостоли святии,/ молите Милостиваго Бога,/ да прегрешений оставление// подаст душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Тропарь апостолов». The text is the common of the apostles and names none of the six; it is the same text the Romanian page prints for the day, and it is copied whole, as the brief directs.

english.text: Holy apostles, pray to the merciful God that He may grant our souls forgiveness of our sins.

hymns.text: Яко священная сокровища Всесвятаго Духа/ и Солнца Славы сияния,/ по долгу воспоим мудрыя апостолы,/ Апеллия, Урвана же и Аристовула,/ Амплия, Наркисса и Стахия,// яже благодать собра Бога нашего.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 31 октября ст. ст. — «Кондак апостолов». It is the Slavonic of the Greek kontakion this folder already holds, and it names all six of the day's apostles, this one first.

english.text: As sacred treasuries of the All-Holy Spirit and rays of the Sun of Glory, let us sing as we ought of the wise apostles — Apelles, Urban and Aristobulus, Ampliatus, Narcissus and Stachys — whom the grace of our God gathered in.

death.note: days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 31 октября ст. ст. closes the six apostles with «(I)», and its life for them is titled with the same «(I)» — the first century. The folder held no `dates` before this; neither doxologia.ro nor saint.gr dated him.
